name: @casepilot/persistence
description: Reusable backend persistence adapters organized by driver/framework

scripts.lint: pnpm build:contracts && eslint src test eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.test: pnpm build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build/test/test/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node build/test/test/run-integration-tests.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
